bmc_ports.description: how many of those ports are BMCs

nodes.description: how many nodes those ports belong to

ports.description: how many of the nodes' ports have an address in the range

prefix_len.description: the prefix length to give a port in the range, the one a search of the range reports

expire.description: string parsed by time.ParseDuration, examples include: infinite, 8h, 30m, 20s

role.description: type of model.Role, valid options: disabled, user, admin

username.description: username shown in logs, does not need to be a valid user in the DB

by_serial.description: Asset tag for each serial number. A selected node whose serial is not listed fails

dry_run.description: Read the bmcs and report what would change, without writing

template.description: Go template rendered per node, such as UB-{{.Name}}. A plain string is a valid template

all.description: Clear every job in the queue. Mutually exclusive with ids

file.description: BMC config template to import, by its name in the provision templates. Each iDRAC downloads it from Grendel's provision server

shutdown_type.description: NoReboot queues the import until the node next reboots. Graceful and Forced reboot the node to apply it. Defaults to NoReboot

apply_update.description: false only compares the installed firmware against the catalog, which firmware/updates then lists. true queues every available update as a job

catalog_file.description: Catalog file name on the share. The iDRAC defaults to Catalog.xml

clear_jobs.description: Clear every job in the queue first. Requires apply_update

ignore_cert_warning.description: Accept an HTTPS share whose certificate does not validate

ip_address.description: Domain name or IP address of the share holding the catalog

reboot.description: Reboot the node when an update needs it. Otherwise the updates wait as scheduled jobs until the node next reboots

share_name.description: Path of the catalog's directory on the share, or the NFS export

dry_run.description: Read the bmcs and report what would change, without writing

rack_unit.description: Must render to a whole number

action.description: schemas.ResetType. On, ForceOn, ForceOff, ForceRestart, GracefulRestart, GracefulShutdown, PowerCycle, Nmi, PushPowerButton, Suspend, Pause, Resume, FullPowerCycle

boot_override.description: schemas.BootSource to boot from once. None, Pxe, Floppy, Cd, Usb, Hdd, BiosSetup, Utilities, Diags, UefiShell, UefiTarget, SDCard, UefiHttp, RemoteDrive, UefiBootNext, Recovery

target.description: What to power, 'host' or 'bmc'. Defaults to host. A bmc target is always a graceful restart and takes no action or boot_override

enabled.description: Whether secure boot is in effect from the next boot

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of a certificate, or the hash of a signature, in hex with or without colons

fingerprints.description: More keys to remove, each named as fingerprint is

id.description: Id of the certificate or signature on the bmc. Ids differ between nodes, so this suits a single node

ids.description: More keys to remove, each named as id is

certificates.description: PEM encoded X.509 certificates, one per entry, enrolled in order. Mutually exclusive with signature

owner.description: UEFI signature owner GUID. Empty lets the bmc choose

signature.description: Hex encoded signature data, such as the SHA-256 of a binary to revoke in dbx. Mutually exclusive with certificates

signature_type.description: UEFI type of the signature. Defaults to EFI_CERT_SHA256_GUID

database.description: Reset only this database, PK, KEK, db or dbx. Empty resets every database

type.description: to-default restores the factory keys, delete-all removes every key, which leaves the system in setup mode, and delete-pk removes only the platform key. delete-pk applies to every database, not one

apply_time.description: When the bmc applies the change. Immediate, OnReset, AtMaintenanceWindowStart or InMaintenanceWindowOnReset, limited to what each bmc accepts. Empty for the bmc's default

attributes.description: Attribute names and their new values. A string value is converted to the number or boolean the attribute holds

type.description: URL of the error type. Can be used to lookup the error in a documentation

after_highest.description: the free addresses after the highest one in use

free.description: how many addresses in the range no node holds, that aren't excluded or reserved

highest.description: the highest address in the range a node holds or that is excluded, which after_highest starts from

lowest.description: the lowest free addresses in the range

prefix_len.description: the prefix length to give a port with one of the suggested addresses

reserved.description: addresses in the range never suggested: the subnet's network and broadcast addresses, the gateway DHCP hands its nodes, and in a subnet larger than a /24, ones ending in .0 or .255

subnet.description: the subnet the range lies in: the one in dhcp.subnets holding it, or else taken from the prefix length of the nodes in and around it, or the range itself when there are none

used.description: addresses in the range a node's port holds, lowest first

from.description: Where in a range to start: lowest, the default, or after_highest

ping.description: Ping the addresses taken from a range and skip any that answer. Only done on a dry run

role.description: type of model.Role, valid options: disabled, user, admin
